text: This solution, Fourth Disaster Risk Management Development Policy Loan with a Catastrophe-Deferred Drawdown Option (CAT-DDO 4) addresses natural catastrophe through public private partnerships in Philippines between Government of the Republic of the Philippines, Local Government Units (LGUs), World Bank (International Bank for Reconstruction and Development, IBRD), International reinsurance and investors, and Microinsurance markets. The program was implemented in 2021 and focuses on collaboration and regulation.
